title: SpaceX launches massive Starship rocket in first test flight since IPO
summary: SpaceX has launched its massive Starship rocket in its first test flight following the company's recent IPO. The milestone marks a significant step forward for Elon Musk's rocket maker in developing its next-generation launch vehicle.
content: Elon Musk's rocket maker is conducting the first test fight for its massive Starship rocket since the company's IPO last month.

zh.title: SpaceX在IPO后首次试飞中发射大型星舰火箭
zh.summary: SpaceX在公司最近上市后进行了大型星舰火箭的首次试飞。这一里程碑标志着埃隆·马斯克的火箭公司在开发下一代运载火箭方面迈出了重要一步。

title: Trump sued hours after new tariffs take effect, as experts say they may not hold up
summary: President Donald Trump has announced new tariffs, including 25% duties on Brazilian imports and planned 50% tariffs on Canadian goods. Legal challenges have already been filed against the tariffs, with experts questioning their legal viability.
content: President Donald Trump has renewed a flurry of tariffs, including slapping 25% duties on Brazilian imports and vowing 50% tariffs on goods from Canada.

zh.title: 新关税生效数小时后特朗普被起诉，专家称其可能站不住脚
zh.summary: 唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布了新的关税，包括对巴西进口商品征收25%的关税以及计划对加拿大商品征收50%的关税。已经对这些关税提出了法律诉讼，专家对其法律可行性提出质疑。
